name: hono-policy-engine
description: Policy engine pod: gha-lite workflow evaluation, net-only, over HTTP

port.description: Port to listen on; 0 lets the OS pick and the bound port is reported

tls-cert-file.description: PEM certificate to serve TLS with; requires tls-key-file

tls-key-file.description: PEM private key to serve TLS with; requires tls-cert-file

port-file.description: File the bound TCP port is written to once listening

listeners-file.description: File every bound listener is reported to as JSON once listening

bundled-actions-dir.description: Directory holding the bundled policy actions a workflow step can use
